paragraphs.text: Millicent is a geist soldier from Innistrad .
She has wild hair, round eyes, strong shoulders, and a furious mouth.

Vengeance is a desire shared by many of the spirits left in the wake of The Travails , and Millicent is no exception. In life, she was mayor and captain of the guard of a small township in Stensia . Having lost her entire family to the various horrors of Innistrad , Millicent wanted to create a sanctuary for other people who had lost those close to them. Her small town grew into a medium-sized city made up of humans learning to heal. The town was wiped off the map by a geistbomb created by the necro-alchemist Cyril Rav.

One by one, Millicent and her citizens rose again as spirits, each with their own unfinished business. The spirits still held on to their sense of community, even in death. Led by Millicent, they travel the plane together, seeking the vengeance each spirit desires. They descend on cities like a natural disaster. A cloud of spirits flood the streets, leaving the dead bodies of corrupt officials or disguised werewolves in their wake.

Millicent and her fellow geists were misused in the experiments of the necro-alchemist Cyril Rav , and she became bent on revenge. She employed Eloise Wicker to find Rav and his accomplice Jacob Hauken .
